RULE_01_PREAUTH_REQ.title: Pre-authorization number missing
RULE_01_PREAUTH_REQ.regulatory_source: IRDAI Cashless Claim Guidelines & Master Circular
RULE_01_PREAUTH_REQ.description: Planned surgical or active inpatient procedures require an approved pre-authorization number from the insurer or TPA prior to settlement.
RULE_01_PREAUTH_REQ.suggested_fix: This claim has a surgery, so the insurer needs the pre-authorization (approval) number. Write the approval number from the insurer's approval letter in the Pre-Auth ID box.
RULE_01_PREAUTH_REQ.patient_action: Ask the hospital's insurance desk for the pre-approval number from the insurance company, and get it written on the claim form.

RULE_02_DATE_CHRONOLOGY.title: Admission and discharge dates don't add up
RULE_02_DATE_CHRONOLOGY.description: Discharge date is recorded prior to admission date, or bill submission date occurs before hospital discharge.
RULE_02_DATE_CHRONOLOGY.suggested_fix: Check the admission and discharge dates and times. Discharge must come after admission, and the dates on the claim form must be the same as on the discharge summary.
RULE_02_DATE_CHRONOLOGY.patient_action: Ask the hospital to check the admission and discharge dates on the claim form and the discharge summary, and correct the wrong one.

RULE_03_DIAG_PROC_MATCH.title: Diagnosis code doesn't match
RULE_03_DIAG_PROC_MATCH.description: The billed surgical or medical procedure code (ICD-10-PCS) does not medically align with the primary admitted diagnosis (ICD-10-CM).
RULE_03_DIAG_PROC_MATCH.suggested_fix: The claim form and the discharge summary show different diagnosis codes (ICD-10). Use the same code on both, the one that matches the doctor's final diagnosis.
RULE_03_DIAG_PROC_MATCH.patient_action: Ask the billing desk to write the same diagnosis code on the claim form and the discharge summary.

RULE_04_MIN_24HR_STAY.title: Stay under 24 hours, not marked as Day Care
RULE_04_MIN_24HR_STAY.regulatory_source: IRDAI Health Regulations (Active Hospitalization Minimum Stay Clause)
RULE_04_MIN_24HR_STAY.description: Hospital stay duration is under 24 hours for an inpatient claim not classified under the insurer's approved day-care procedure list.
RULE_04_MIN_24HR_STAY.suggested_fix: The patient stayed less than 24 hours. Mark the admission as 'Day Care' if the treatment is on the day-care list, or correct the admission/discharge times.
RULE_04_MIN_24HR_STAY.patient_action: You stayed less than 24 hours. Ask the hospital to mark the claim as "Day Care" on the claim form.

RULE_05_NAME_MISMATCH.title: Patient name spelled differently
RULE_05_NAME_MISMATCH.regulatory_source: ABDM FHIR Patient Verification & KYC Norms
RULE_05_NAME_MISMATCH.description: Discrepancy detected between patient name spellings across Claim Form Part A, Claim Form Part B, and Discharge Summary.
RULE_05_NAME_MISMATCH.suggested_fix: Write the patient's name exactly the same on every document, matching their ID card (Aadhaar / policy card).
RULE_05_NAME_MISMATCH.patient_action: Your name is spelled differently on the documents. Ask the hospital to correct it so it matches your policy card exactly.

RULE_06_GENDER_CLINIC_MISMATCH.title: Diagnosis doesn't fit the patient's gender
RULE_06_GENDER_CLINIC_MISMATCH.description: The documented primary ICD-10 code is anatomically restricted to a gender different from the patient's recorded demographic profile.
RULE_06_GENDER_CLINIC_MISMATCH.suggested_fix: The diagnosis code or procedure is only possible for the other gender (for example a pregnancy code for a male patient). Check the patient's gender and the diagnosis code.
RULE_06_GENDER_CLINIC_MISMATCH.patient_action: The diagnosis doesn't fit the patient's gender, which is usually a typing mistake. Ask the doctor to check and correct the diagnosis.

RULE_07_DOCTOR_REG_MISSING.title: Doctor's registration number missing
RULE_07_DOCTOR_REG_MISSING.regulatory_source: IRDAI Claim Form Part B (Section A - Facility Details)
RULE_07_DOCTOR_REG_MISSING.description: The treating doctor's profile is missing their State Medical Council or National Medical Commission (NMC) registration number.
RULE_07_DOCTOR_REG_MISSING.suggested_fix: Add the treating doctor's medical council registration number (for example DMC/12345) on the claim form.
RULE_07_DOCTOR_REG_MISSING.patient_action: Ask the hospital to write the treating doctor's registration number on the claim form.

RULE_08_HOSPITAL_ID_MISSING.title: Hospital ROHINI ID missing
RULE_08_HOSPITAL_ID_MISSING.description: Missing unique ROHINI facility code or TPA network hospital identification code.
RULE_08_HOSPITAL_ID_MISSING.suggested_fix: Add the hospital's 13-digit ROHINI ID in Section A. You can find it on the hospital's insurance empanelment certificate.
RULE_08_HOSPITAL_ID_MISSING.patient_action: Ask the hospital's insurance desk to write their ROHINI ID (the hospital's ID with insurers) on the claim form.

RULE_09_SPECIALTY_MISMATCH.title: Surgery billed without a surgeon
RULE_09_SPECIALTY_MISMATCH.regulatory_source: National Medical Commission (NMC) Clinical Governance Norms
RULE_09_SPECIALTY_MISMATCH.description: The treating doctor's recorded medical qualification/specialty does not correspond with the specialty required for the billed surgical procedure.
RULE_09_SPECIALTY_MISMATCH.suggested_fix: A surgery is billed, but the doctor listed is not a surgeon and no operating surgeon is named. Add the operating surgeon's name and qualification.
RULE_09_SPECIALTY_MISMATCH.patient_action: A surgery is billed, but no surgeon is named. Ask the hospital to add the surgeon's name and qualification to the claim form.

RULE_10_DUPLICATE_LINE_ITEM.title: Same item billed twice
RULE_10_DUPLICATE_LINE_ITEM.description: Identical itemized bill charge (such as consultant visit, bed charge, or specific diagnostic test) billed multiple times for the same calendar date.
RULE_10_DUPLICATE_LINE_ITEM.suggested_fix: The bill has the same item, date and amount more than once. Remove the duplicate line.
RULE_10_DUPLICATE_LINE_ITEM.patient_action: Something is charged twice on the bill. Ask the billing desk to check it and give you a corrected bill.

RULE_11_UNITEMIZED_ROOM_RENT.title: Room rent billed as one lump sum
RULE_11_UNITEMIZED_ROOM_RENT.regulatory_source: IRDAI Standardized Billing Guidelines (Room Rent Sub-Limits)
RULE_11_UNITEMIZED_ROOM_RENT.description: Room rent, nursing fees, and RMO charges are consolidated into a single lump sum rather than itemized per calendar day.
RULE_11_UNITEMIZED_ROOM_RENT.suggested_fix: Show room rent day by day (room charges, nursing charges and doctor visits for each day) instead of one total.
RULE_11_UNITEMIZED_ROOM_RENT.patient_action: Ask the billing desk for a day-by-day breakup of the room charges.

RULE_12_IMPLANT_INVOICE_MISSING.title: Implant bill or sticker missing
RULE_12_IMPLANT_INVOICE_MISSING.regulatory_source: IRDAI Claim Form Part B (Mandatory Checklist Section)
RULE_12_IMPLANT_INVOICE_MISSING.description: High-value implants, stents, or mesh are billed without accompanying manufacturer invoices, batch numbers, or sticker tags.
RULE_12_IMPLANT_INVOICE_MISSING.suggested_fix: An implant (like a stent or plate) was used. Attach the implant's invoice and the sticker from its packet.
RULE_12_IMPLANT_INVOICE_MISSING.patient_action: Ask the hospital for the implant's invoice and the sticker from its box, and attach both to the claim.

RULE_13_DATE_DISCREPANCY_BILL.title: Bill items dated outside the hospital stay
RULE_13_DATE_DISCREPANCY_BILL.description: Investigation or pharmacy bill dates fall outside the documented admission and discharge date interval without pre/post-hospitalization classification.
RULE_13_DATE_DISCREPANCY_BILL.suggested_fix: Some bill items are dated before admission or after discharge. Move them to pre/post-hospitalisation expenses or correct the dates.
RULE_13_DATE_DISCREPANCY_BILL.patient_action: Some bill items are dated outside your hospital stay. Ask the billing desk to correct or remove them.

RULE_14_FILING_DEADLINE_RISK.title: Claim is close to (or past) the deadline
RULE_14_FILING_DEADLINE_RISK.description: Claim submission date approaches or exceeds the regulatory submission window (standard 15 days for cashless dossier dispatch).
RULE_14_FILING_DEADLINE_RISK.suggested_fix: Submit the claim as soon as possible. If it is already late, attach a short letter explaining the reason for the delay.
RULE_14_FILING_DEADLINE_RISK.patient_action: Send the claim to the insurance company as soon as possible. If you are late, attach a short letter explaining why.

RULE_15_MISSING_MANDATORY_DOCS.title: Required documents not attached
RULE_15_MISSING_MANDATORY_DOCS.regulatory_source: IRDAI Claim Form Part B Enclosure Checklist
RULE_15_MISSING_MANDATORY_DOCS.description: Mandatory checklist enclosures in Part B (such as indoor case papers, detailed discharge summary, or doctor prescriptions) are marked missing.
RULE_15_MISSING_MANDATORY_DOCS.suggested_fix: Attach the documents listed in the issue and tick them in the document checklist.
RULE_15_MISSING_MANDATORY_DOCS.patient_action: Some papers are not marked as attached on the claim form. Get them from the hospital and attach them (see the list of missing documents).

RULE_16_ARITHMETIC_TOTAL_MISMATCH.title: Bill total doesn't add up
RULE_16_ARITHMETIC_TOTAL_MISMATCH.description: The calculated mathematical sum of individual itemized charges does not equal the gross claimed total amount in Part A/B.
RULE_16_ARITHMETIC_TOTAL_MISMATCH.suggested_fix: The separate charges don't add up to the total claimed amount. Recalculate and correct either the charges or the total.
RULE_16_ARITHMETIC_TOTAL_MISMATCH.patient_action: The charges don't add up to the total claimed. Ask the billing desk to correct the amounts on the claim form.

RULE_17_INVESTIGATION_ONLY_FLAG.title: Looks like an admission only for tests
RULE_17_INVESTIGATION_ONLY_FLAG.regulatory_source: IRDAI Standard Policy Exclusions (Clause: Diagnostic Hospitalization)
RULE_17_INVESTIGATION_ONLY_FLAG.description: Inpatient record reflects diagnostic evaluations and investigations without active pharmacological or surgical treatment administered.
RULE_17_INVESTIGATION_ONLY_FLAG.suggested_fix: Insurers often reject admissions that were only for tests. Make sure the discharge summary clearly shows the treatment given (for example IV medicines or monitoring).
RULE_17_INVESTIGATION_ONLY_FLAG.patient_action: It looks like you were admitted only for tests, which insurers often refuse. Ask the doctor to write in the discharge summary why you had to stay in hospital.

RULE_18_BANK_DETAILS_MISSING.title: Bank details missing
RULE_18_BANK_DETAILS_MISSING.description: Bank account number, IFSC code, or bank branch details are absent from Claim Form Part A Section F.
RULE_18_BANK_DETAILS_MISSING.suggested_fix: Add the account number and IFSC code of the insured person's bank account so the money can be paid.
RULE_18_BANK_DETAILS_MISSING.patient_action: Fill in your bank details (account number and IFSC code) on the claim form, and attach a cancelled cheque.

RULE_19_ICD_CODE_INVALID.title: Diagnosis code is not valid
RULE_19_ICD_CODE_INVALID.regulatory_source: WHO ICD-10 / ICD-10-CM code structure; IRDAI Health Insurance Regulations (standard coding)
RULE_19_ICD_CODE_INVALID.description: The primary ICD-10 code is malformed, belongs to no ICD-10 chapter, or is implausible for the patient's age.
RULE_19_ICD_CODE_INVALID.suggested_fix: The diagnosis code is not a real ICD-10 code or doesn't fit the patient's age. Use a valid code: one letter, two numbers, and optionally a dot with more numbers (for example K35.80).
RULE_19_ICD_CODE_INVALID.patient_action: The diagnosis code on the claim form is not a real code. Ask the billing desk to write the correct one.

RULE_20_ICD_DESCRIPTION_MISMATCH.title: Diagnosis code doesn't match the written diagnosis
RULE_20_ICD_DESCRIPTION_MISMATCH.regulatory_source: ICD-10 Official Coding Guidelines; TPA medical scrutiny practice
RULE_20_ICD_DESCRIPTION_MISMATCH.description: The written diagnosis points to a different body system than the ICD-10 code entered on the claim, a common trigger for medical-scrutiny queries.
RULE_20_ICD_DESCRIPTION_MISMATCH.suggested_fix: The code written on the claim is for a different illness than the diagnosis written next to it. Use the suggested code, or the code that matches the doctor's diagnosis.
RULE_20_ICD_DESCRIPTION_MISMATCH.patient_action: The diagnosis code doesn't match the diagnosis written in words. Ask the doctor or billing desk to correct one of them.

RULE_21_CLAIM_VS_BILLS.title: Claimed amount doesn't match the bills
RULE_21_CLAIM_VS_BILLS.description: The total claimed amount on the claim form differs from the totals printed on the uploaded hospital and pharmacy bills.
RULE_21_CLAIM_VS_BILLS.suggested_fix: Make the total claimed amount on the claim form equal to the final hospital bill (plus the pharmacy bills, if you claim them separately). If part of the bill is not being claimed, say why.
RULE_21_CLAIM_VS_BILLS.patient_action: The amount on the claim form is different from your bills. Ask the billing desk to check the total, and make sure every bill you are claiming for is attached.

RULE_22_POLICY_NUMBER_MISSING.title: Policy number missing
RULE_22_POLICY_NUMBER_MISSING.regulatory_source: IRDAI Standard Claim Form (Part A) & TPA Claim Processing Guidelines
RULE_22_POLICY_NUMBER_MISSING.description: Part A of the claim form, filled in by the insured, does not carry the policy number.
RULE_22_POLICY_NUMBER_MISSING.suggested_fix: Write the policy number in Part A. It is printed on the policy document and on the health / e-card from the insurer or TPA.
RULE_22_POLICY_NUMBER_MISSING.patient_action: Write your policy number in Part A of the claim form. You can find it on your policy papers or on your health card / e-card.

RULE_23_PART_A_DETAILS_MISMATCH.title: Part A and Part B don't match
RULE_23_PART_A_DETAILS_MISMATCH.regulatory_source: IRDAI Standard Claim Form & TPA Claim Processing Guidelines
RULE_23_PART_A_DETAILS_MISMATCH.description: The patient's name or the hospital stay dates in Part A (insured) differ from Part B (hospital).
RULE_23_PART_A_DETAILS_MISMATCH.suggested_fix: Make the patient's name and the admission and discharge dates the same in Part A and Part B, as on the discharge summary.
RULE_23_PART_A_DETAILS_MISMATCH.patient_action: Your part of the claim form (Part A) and the hospital's part (Part B) don't match. Copy the name and dates exactly as they are on the discharge summary.

RULE_24_PART_A_AMOUNT_MISMATCH.title: Claimed amounts don't agree
RULE_24_PART_A_AMOUNT_MISMATCH.description: Part A's expense lines do not add up to its total, or its hospitalization expenses differ from Part B's total.
RULE_24_PART_A_AMOUNT_MISMATCH.suggested_fix: Make Part A's hospitalization expenses equal to the total in Part B and the final bill, and check that Part A's lines add up to its total.
RULE_24_PART_A_AMOUNT_MISMATCH.patient_action: The amounts you wrote in Part A don't match the hospital's total in Part B. Check them against your final hospital bill and correct the one that is wrong.

RULE_25_INSURED_CONTACT_MISSING.title: Your contact details are missing
RULE_25_INSURED_CONTACT_MISSING.description: Part A has no phone number or address for the insured, so the insurer cannot reach them.
RULE_25_INSURED_CONTACT_MISSING.suggested_fix: Fill in the insured person's phone number and full address in Part A.
RULE_25_INSURED_CONTACT_MISSING.patient_action: Write your phone number and full address in Part A, so the insurance company can contact you.
